Assam Congress Leader Gaurav Gogoi Detained During Protest

Assam Congress chief Gaurav Gogoi was detained on Tuesday while participating in a protest against the Chief Election Commissioner (CEC). The protest was organized by the Assam Congress. Details regarding the specific reasons for the protest or the exact circumstances of the detention were not provided in the coverage.
